usage: Used for living plants in a general sense, from houseplants to wild plants and crops.
Common in everyday speech and writing; it sounds neutral and natural in both spoken Cantonese and standard written Chinese.
Often appears in phrases about growing, buying, caring for, or studying plants, such as at home, in school, or in a garden.
As a countable noun, it can refer to one plant or many plants depending on context; the plural is usually shown by context, not by changing the word.
